about_the_game:
Zhuyang "is a plot oriented galgame, originally designed as a demo version, which tells the story of seven days before the story takes place. After the protagonist meets foreign girls, they fight side by side to defeat evil.

The demo version has a total of about 60000 words and a duration of approximately 2 hours.

                                    

Izewei's young security officer meets a mysterious girl from a distant land and embarks on a fantastic adventure.

No matter ancient or modern, from east to west, some things remain unchanged. After experiencing many things, what choices will young people make?

This is the journey of "dispelling disasters" - the journey of eliminating calamities.

-Stage-

Izeve, the abandoned town of God, and the wider world.

Why are gods born, exist, and leave?

-Story-

A fire swept Sheriff Frey into a disaster.

Unknown shadows, mysterious girls, and even the "legend" itself... Frey is forced to know more and more "secrets".

However, this is not just a journey to uncover the truth.

Darkness breeds in the shadows, natural disasters and man-made calamities, and all effects have causes.

Everything may change with the 'choice'

Or perhaps, under divine scrutiny, there is no other choice?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some anime violence elements, as well as some revealing and indecent clothing.
